title: My 10 year old made an ai game, how can i get people to test it?
author: PureMechanic8414
selftext:
Hello, 

my 10 year old made a game using ai, ive helped him a bit with balance because he gets carried away with making something super over powered which makes the game pretty boring in the long run. Its actually pretty fun at this point, his friends and cousins seem to love it and I don't even mind it. 

  
My question is how do i get it tested for bugs etc if he ever wanted it to release on steam? I made this youtube channel for him to show the game, but he has gone and built some sort of bot city that builds clips and posts short videos.

  
Im not that old, but he is clearly better at me with the ai stuff.

comments.author: TraplineStudio
comments.body: itch.io is the easiest place to start, it's free and r/playmygame is full of people who like trying small games. Ask testers to send a screenshot or a short recording when something breaks, that's way more useful than "it crashed". If he ever wants Steam, you'd be the one signing up for Steamworks since you need to be an adult. And a 10 year old with a bot that cuts and posts his own clips is ahead of most of us lol

replies.author: PureMechanic8414
replies.body:
yes i did preemptively create that account. yes i am actually more impressed by the mini cat youtube city production then i am the game

/e the bank was my idea so he knows how much he has to earn with bottle drives/neighborhood jobs
